findings.note: Shell/drawer composition holds under component tests; live four-persona browser pass still required at release.
End-to-end promotion closure gate: durable proposal-to-recorded-outcome path proven against the executable engine.
Semantic action launcher draws from one authorized projection; no second eligibility rule.
Organization tree keeps authorized ancestors, address/locale state and non-leaking denied fields.
Information architecture holds destination hierarchy with authorized grouping.
Shared vocabulary and task-oriented copy enforced across navigation and pages.
Acting context (persona, delegation, representation) never widens authority or disclosure.
People table keeps paired scroll/sticky ownership; 0px column drift makes every worker reachable.
Roles surface scales with paging, progressive access sections and compact hierarchy.
Role policy simulation explains effective access without returning forbidden records.
Studio admission and publication stay governed; conformance pins the boundary.
Layout-shift budgets enforced with fault coverage; warm-load fencing keeps the organization subject.
Help actions stay authorized, localized and reachable from global search.
Login/persona copy matches the menu with durable-policy security and regression pins.
Home separates assigned work from visible journeys; promotion is a contextual quick action with cleared directory filters.
Worker identity anchors title/breadcrumb/document; PRESENT/MISSING/UNKNOWN/WITHHELD stay distinct and fail closed.
My Work is an urgency-ordered action queue, Journeys a lifecycle tracker; row facts survive 390px widths.
Insights shows evidence-backed measures or a purposeful insufficient-data state; unassigned visible work is not attention.
History shares one filter bar, sortable columns, server pagination and evidence detail across global and person scope.
Organization browsing offers summary, fuzzy search, density and expand/collapse with progressive rows.
Worker ID admin forms use grouped sections, live governed preview, unsaved-change protection and a sticky action bar.

Appearance uses an upload plus authorized asset picker with validated types/dimensions/safety, original-plus-proxy revisions, five preview variants, exact save diff, removal and rollback; no typed paths.
Settings groups Profile, language/region, accessibility, notifications, navigation, sessions/security and sign-out; tenant appearance links out; sensitive actions are distinct and keyboard reachable.
Closed with no production change: navigation identity, hierarchy and fuzzy authorized search already meet the bar; mutation-verified suite pins it.
Visual-design-system gate holds token, SSR, accessibility, i18n, performance and regression checks over production composition.

live_browser_harness: MANUAL at release (this repository's CI does not execute browser runs): sign in as the four development personas and cover Home, My Work, People, Person, Journeys, History, Organization, Insights, Help, Settings, Appearance and authorized Admin pages at 1440/390/320px in light, dark, reduced-motion, en-US, de-DE and RTL modes; complete and review one promotion; check focus, keyboard, loading, empty, error and recovery states; capture visual baselines; enforce latency and layout-shift budgets. Precedent: UXAUDIT-024 shipped its Playwright spec unexecuted with the live run recorded as evidence.
